note: Scored company-research cards for Lo Cambio. Facts from research/00–06 and SOURCES.md only.

areas.name: Cambio · företaget
areas.description: Company, products, customers, regulation and the public job ad — facts from the cited research pack (00–06 / SOURCES.md).

cards.prompt: När och var grundades Cambio?

options.label: 1993 i Linköping
1998 i Stockholm
1993 i Colombo
2019 i Stockholm, när Sanolium bildades

cards.hint: Två studenter, tidigt 90-tal, Östergötland.
cards.reword: Cambio was founded in which year and city?
cards.explain: Cambio’s history page: founded in Linköping in 1993 by two students. The first assignment was a journal system for private clinics in Stockholm County. [S2]

cards.prompt: Where does the 2025 annual report place Cambio’s head office?

options.label: Stockholm
Linköping
Colombo
Reading

cards.hint: Årsredovisningens rubrik anger huvudkontoret i huvudstaden.
cards.reword: Var ligger huvudkontoret enligt årsredovisningen 2025?
cards.explain: The 2025 annual report headline places the head office in Stockholm. The founding story and the MDR manufacturer address are Linköping — HQ versus historic/legal manufacturing site. [S4, S2, S37]

cards.prompt: Vad är Cambio COSMIC?

options.label: Ett journalsystem (EHR) för regional hälso- och sjukvård
Ett kommunalt omsorgssystem
En öppen hälsodataplattform enligt openEHR
Ett intensivvårdssystem (PDMS)

cards.hint: Det system vårdpersonalen journalför i.
cards.reword: What kind of product is COSMIC?
cards.explain: COSMIC is positioned as the leading electronic health record system in the Nordics: a coordinated regional EHR so bookings, results, medications and treatments share one patient view. [S9]

cards.prompt: Hur många av Sveriges 21 regioner använder eller ska använda COSMIC enligt årsredovisningen 2025?
cards.hint: Inte alla, men nästan alla — två saknas.
cards.reword: According to the 2025 annual report, COSMIC is contracted in how many of 21 regions?
cards.explain: The 2025 annual report and the Swedish about-page: 19 of 21 regions use or will use COSMIC. The English about-page’s “17 of 21” is the older live count, before Stockholm and Gotland. 14 of 21 is MittVaccin’s contracted figure. [S4, S1, S5, S18]

cards.prompt: What is Cambio Viva for?

options.label: Municipal social services, healthcare and care
The regional main electronic health record
Ambient clinical documentation inside COSMIC
A national vaccination record

cards.hint: Kommun, inte region.
cards.reword: Vad används Cambio Viva till?
cards.explain: Viva is a process system for municipal social services, healthcare and care, with published modules such as Viva HSL, IFO, UTF and ÄO. [S14]

cards.prompt: Vad handlar Associate AI Engineer-annonsen främst om?

options.label: Att hjälpa kollegor internt att arbeta smartare med AI
Att sitta i Companion-produktteamet och skriva i patientens journal
Att sälja COSMIC till nya regioner
Att träna egna grundmodeller på patientdata

cards.hint: Annonsens nyckelmening: helping hundreds of colleagues work smarter through AI.
cards.reword: On the face of the job ad, who are the main users of what this associate would build?
cards.explain: The public ad (DevJobs mirror) leads with helping hundreds of colleagues work smarter through AI: discover pain points, prototype agents and automations, measure impact. That is an internal-enablement role, not a job description for shipping COSMIC Companion. [S51]

cards.prompt: What office pattern does the Associate AI Engineer ad state?

options.label: Hybrid, three days per week in the office
Fully remote
Five days a week on-site
Two weeks in Stockholm and two in Linköping

cards.hint: Ett visst antal kontorsdagar i veckan stod i annonsen.
cards.reword: Hur mycket kontorstid nämner annonsen?
cards.explain: The ad: hybrid, three days per week in-office. Place: Stockholm or Linköping. [S51]

cards.prompt: Vilket journalsystem ska COSMIC ersätta i Region Stockholm?

options.label: TakeCare
Millennium
Epic
Viva

cards.hint: Systemet som använts i Stockholm sedan 1995.
cards.reword: Which incumbent EHR will Cosmic replace in Region Stockholm?
cards.explain: Region Stockholm awarded Cosmic to replace TakeCare (in use since 1995), with Cosmic targeted in place by December 2029. [S26]

cards.prompt: Vilket personalantal ska du föredra om någon frågar hur stort Cambio är?

options.label: 1 100 i headcount vid utgången av 2025, enligt den reviderade årsredovisningen
Around 900, som på den engelska about-sidan
Cirka 170 000 — det är koncernens anställda
Cirka 250, som i Stockholms upphandlingsprojekt

cards.hint: Svenska about-sidan säger «runt 1 100»; lita på 2025 års tabell framför den engelska sidan.
cards.reword: Which headcount figure is the one to quote from the 2025 annual report?
cards.explain: Year-end 2025 sustainability KPIs: 1,100 headcount / 1,081 FTE / average FTE 1,021. The English about-page still says “around 900” and should be treated as stale. “More than 170,000 users” is a usage figure, not staff. [S4, S1, S5, S6]

cards.prompt: Stockholm, Linköping and Colombo all appear in Cambio’s office list. What is Colombo described as?

options.label: A software-engineering location, not a published customer market
Cambio’s head office
The group’s main Nordic sales market
A regional EHR customer

cards.hint: Sri Lanka i årsredovisningen är utveckling, inte en säljmarknad.
cards.reword: Vad är kontoret i Colombo enligt källorna?
cards.explain: The contact page lists Cambio Software Engineering in Colombo. The 2025 report treats Sri Lanka as engineering headcount (353 average employees / 376 headcount), not as a customer geography. [S3, S4]

cards.prompt: Vem äger Cambio-koncernen i grova drag enligt årsredovisningen 2025?

options.label: Ungefär 80 % Investcorp via holdingbolag, ungefär 20 % medarbetare och nyckelpersoner
Börsnoterat med spritt aktieägarägande
Helägt av Region Stockholm
Helägt av grundarna utan extern ägare

cards.hint: Ett investmentbolag har majoriteten; personal har en minoritetspost.
cards.reword: Who is the majority owner described in the 2025 annual report?
cards.explain: Sanolium Group Holding AB is owned approximately 80% by Investcorp and approximately 20% by employees and other key individuals. The reporting parent is Sanolium AB (publ). Prefer that picture rather than inventing a cleaner registry diagram. [S4]

cards.prompt: What sits at the heart of Cambio Platform as publicly described?

options.label: A Clinical Data Repository fully based on openEHR
A FHIR-only integration bus with no data store
Ambient speech-to-text
A municipal case-management module

cards.hint: En CDR enligt en öppen journaldatamodell.
cards.reword: Vad är kärnan i Cambio Platform?
cards.explain: Cambio Platform is publicly “the future health data platform”. At its heart is a Clinical Data Repository fully based on openEHR, plus Core Services (patient register mapped to an openEHR EHR id, SNOMED CT) and openEHR-forms. [S10]

cards.prompt: Vad är standarden Cambio Open Services främst exponerar?

options.label: FHIR-profiler, plus några REST-API:er som de vill fasa mot FHIR
Enbart HL7 v2-meddelanden
Enbart openEHR AQL utåt
GraphQL som enda offentliga gränssnitt

cards.hint: Default för integrationer och partners, enligt FHIR Demo 2024 och utvecklarportalen.
cards.reword: What API style is default in Cambio Open Services?
cards.explain: Most Open Services APIs are FHIR profiles adapted to COSMIC; remaining REST APIs are intended to be replaced with FHIR over time. At FHIR Demo 2024 Cambio wrote that FHIR is its default standard for integrations and partners. The developer portal is powered by Azure API Management — that is the portal, not a claim about COSMIC production hosting. [S22, S35]

cards.prompt: Vad är första steget i COSMIC Companion?

options.label: En inbyggd ambient scribe som skriver journalutkast från samtalet, som klinikern ska granska
Ett regelbaserat strokelarm (CHA2DS2-VASc)
Ett fristående fönster utanför COSMIC
Automatiska beställningar som skickas utan godkännande

cards.hint: Digital kollega inuti COSMIC: utkast, inte autoskick.
cards.reword: What does COSMIC Companion do first, according to the product page?
cards.explain: Companion’s first step is Ambient Scribe: it listens to the clinician–patient conversation and creates structured draft notes in real time, following COSMIC’s patient context. Upcoming “smarta beställningar” are suggestions for the clinician to review and approve — not silent send. [S13]

cards.prompt: What is Cambio’s published direction for LeapScribe?

options.label: Acquired in 2025, folded into COSMIC Companion; standalone LeapScribe is being wound down
It remains the main standalone AI product
It was never acquired
It replaced COSMIC as the regional EHR

cards.hint: Köpt 27 juni 2025; den 2 november 2026 sade de att fristående LeapScribe fasas ut på tre månader.
cards.reword: Vad hände med LeapScribe enligt Cambio?
cards.explain: LeapScribe Sverige AB was acquired on 27 June 2025. On 13 October 2025 the ambient scribe was renamed Cambio COSMIC Companion. On 2 November 2026 Cambio said it will wind down standalone LeapScribe over three months and put AI directly into COSMIC and the wider portfolio. [S4, S20, S21]

cards.prompt: Hur räknas «19 av 21 regioner» ihop?

options.label: 17 regioner kör redan COSMIC; Stockholm och Gotland är kontrakterade utöver det
19 regioner är redan live
Alla 21 regioner plus två sjukhus
Bara de nio Sussa-regionerna

cards.hint: Live-siffran på Sussa-sidan är 17; två stora avtal tillkom 2025.
cards.reword: Why do some pages say 17 regions and others say 19?
cards.explain: Cambio’s Sussa page: COSMIC is used in 17 regions plus Capio S:t Göran. Stockholm and Gotland take the contracted total to 19 of 21. [S24, S4]

cards.prompt: What is Sussa Samverkan in Cambio’s telling?

options.label: Nine regions that jointly procured COSMIC, now all live, delivered as a managed service
The eight long-standing KGC regions plus Capio S:t Göran
Stockholm and Gotland’s shared implementation office
A Danish intensive-care network

cards.hint: Nio regioner, live 2024–2025, managed service.
cards.reword: Vad är Sussa i Cambio-sammanhang?
cards.explain: Sussa’s nine regions: Blekinge, Dalarna, Gävleborg, Halland, Norrbotten, Sörmland, Västerbotten, Västernorrland and Örebro län. Joint procurement awarded in 2018; Cambio says all nine are now live, implemented as a managed service. [S24, S4]

cards.prompt: Vad stämmer om Region Stockholm och Region Gotlands COSMIC-avtal?

options.label: Tilldelning 18 feb 2025, kontrakt 18 nov 2025, införande sikte december 2029, ersätter TakeCare
Kontrakt 2018 som redan är live i hela regionen
Införande redan klart under 2025
Ersätter Viva i Stockholms stad

cards.hint: Överklaganden efter tilldelningen; påskrift i november 2025.
cards.reword: When was the Stockholm/Gotland Cosmic contract signed, and when is go-live targeted?
cards.explain: Regionstyrelsen awarded the main EHR contract to Cambio / Cosmic on 18 February 2025, jointly with Gotland. After appeals the contract was signed on 18 November 2025. TakeCare remains until the new system is in place, estimated December 2029. [S26, S27, S28]

cards.prompt: How should you tell CDS apart from Companion?

options.label: CDS is published as rules-and-guidelines decision support; Companion is generative/ambient documentation with human review
They are two names for the same generative model
CDS drafts notes from the consultation; Companion computes CHA2DS2-VASc
Companion is only for municipalities; CDS is only for vaccination

cards.hint: Det ena är riktlinjer och regler; det andra skriver utkast från samtalet.
cards.reword: Vad är skillnaden mellan Cambio CDS och COSMIC Companion?
cards.explain: CDS combines patient-specific data with evidence-based rules (the published Stroke Prevention App adapts Socialstyrelsen guidelines and computes CHA2DS2-VASc). Recommendations are described as non-intrusive; the clinician decides. Companion is an in-COSMIC ambient scribe first, later suggested actions with explicit review. Don’t blur the two. [S11, S13]

cards.prompt: Finns det ett «nytt» och ett «gammalt» Cosmic enligt Cambio?

options.label: Nej — alla svenska kunder använder samma Cosmic, men konfigurationen skiljer sig åt
Ja, Sussa kör en ny produkt och KGC en gammal
Ja, Stockholm får en moln-only-variant som ingen annan har
Ja, Companion ersätter Cosmic som journalsystem

cards.hint: Samma produkt i versioner; den kan se olika ut i två regioner.
cards.reword: Is there a separate “new Cosmic” and “old Cosmic”?
cards.explain: Cambio says there is not a new and an old Cosmic: all Swedish customers use the same Cosmic, released in versions, but configuration differs by customer — which is why it can look different in two regions. [S24, S27]

cards.prompt: openEHR eller FHIR — vad använder Cambio enligt de publika sidorna?

options.label: Båda, till olika jobb: openEHR i Platforms datalager, FHIR som default för integrationer
Bara openEHR, aldrig FHIR
Bara FHIR, ingen datalagring
De har bytt till en egen sluten modell

cards.hint: Inte antingen-eller.
cards.reword: Do Cambio’s public pages treat openEHR and FHIR as an either/or choice?
cards.explain: openEHR is how Platform describes the CDR and forms. FHIR is how they say they want to expose and integrate — default for new interfaces and partners, plus Open Services. They solve different jobs. [S10, S22, S35]

cards.prompt: In IMY’s general description, who is the controller when a vendor runs a journal system for a region?

options.label: The care provider (vårdgivaren) is controller; the supplier is typically a processor
The EHR vendor is always the controller
The patient is the controller for the whole record
The group’s majority owner is the controller

cards.hint: Vårdgivaren är personuppgiftsansvarig; leverantören är typiskt biträde.
cards.reword: Vem är personuppgiftsansvarig när en leverantör kör ett journalsystem åt en region?
cards.explain: IMY’s general description of an IT journal-system vendor — not a Cambio-specific legal opinion: the care provider remains controller (personuppgiftsansvarig); the supplier is typically a processor (biträde). Health data are a special category under GDPR; Swedish complements include patientdatalagen (2008:355). [S39, S40, S38]

cards.prompt: Är Epic ett regionalt huvudjournalsystem i Sverige enligt källorna i research-packen?

options.label: Nej — den levande nordiska jämförelsen är Danmark (Köpenhamn); svenska jätteupphandlingar har gällt Cosmic, TakeCare, Systematic och Millennium
Ja, Epic vann Stockholm 2025
Ja, Skåne kör Epic live som huvudjournal
Ja, alla regioner utanför Sussa kör Epic

cards.hint: Sundhedsplatformen, inte en svensk regionvinnare i de här källorna.
cards.reword: What do the cited sources say about Epic in Sweden versus Denmark?
cards.explain: SVT refers to Epic in Copenhagen (Sundhedsplatformen). No source in this pack names Epic as a live main EHR in a Swedish region. Recent Swedish mega-procurements have been Cosmic versus TakeCare/CGM, Systematic and Millennium. [S49, S26]

cards.prompt: Om de frågar om den offentliga kritiken mot Cosmic och patientsäkerhet — vad är den mest rimliga hållningen?

options.label: Erkänn att det finns offentlig rapportering och en pågående regionsgranskning; diagnostisera inte enskilda fall du inte har läst
Lista detaljer från granskningen som om du själv utrett fallen
Avfärda journalistiken som påhitt utan att ha läst underlaget
Påstå att du känner den medicinska orsaken i varje omtalat fall

cards.hint: Acknowledge, don’t litigate.
cards.reword: If asked about public Cosmic patient-safety coverage, what should you do?
cards.explain: The research pack’s advice: acknowledge the public reporting and that regions have commissioned a review; do not invent clinical conclusions; do not attack journalists or defend case facts you have not read. Large EHR go-lives are socio-technical — product, configuration, training and workflow all show up in deviations. [S47, S48, S24]

cards.prompt: The English about-page still says “around 900” staff and “17 of 21 regions”. What should you do with that?

options.label: Treat it as stale; prefer the Swedish about-page and the 2025 annual report
Prefer the English page because it is written for international readers
Average the two headcounts and say about 1 000 without a source
Ignore the annual report when it disagrees with the website

cards.hint: SOURCES.md säger uttryckligen att den engelska sidan släpar efter [S1] och [S4].
cards.reword: Vilka siffror ska du inte citera från cambiogroup.com/about-us utan reservation?
cards.explain: The English about-page ([S5]) still says “around 900” and “17 of 21 regions”, which conflict with the Swedish about-page and the 2025 annual report (about 1,100 staff; 19 of 21 regions). Prefer [S1] and [S4]. [S5, S1, S4]

cards.prompt: Vad är Sanolium AB i förhållande till Cambio?

options.label: Moderbolaget i årsredovisningen 2025; publikt obligationsemittent, inte ett noterat aktiebolag
Det danska säljbolaget
Ett regionägt holdingbolag
Namnet på journalsystemet före COSMIC

cards.hint: Org.nr 559176-1423; ägs uppåt via Sanolium Holding / Group Holding.
cards.reword: What is Sanolium AB (publ)?
cards.explain: The 2025 annual and sustainability report is issued by Sanolium AB (publ). The group issued a corporate bond in 2019 and is therefore a public bond issuer, not listed equity. The employer on the Associate AI Engineer ad is Cambio Healthcare Systems AB. [S4, S51]

cards.prompt: Vilka två regioner saknar Cosmic-avtal enligt rapportering i augusti 2026?

options.label: Skåne och Västra Götaland, som gått Millennium-vägar som båda senare övergavs
Stockholm och Gotland
Uppsala och Östergötland
Halland och Blekinge

cards.hint: De två storregionerna i söder och väst.
cards.reword: Which two regions were reported as being outside a Cosmic contract in August 2026?
cards.explain: Svensk Farmaci (20 August 2026): only Skåne and Västra Götaland had chosen Millennium. In April 2026 Region Skåne decided to stop its Millennium variant (SDV) and compare alternatives; VGR decided the same month to scrap Millennium and pursue a modular system. [S48]

cards.prompt: What is KGC — Kundgrupp Cosmic?

options.label: Eight long-standing regions plus privately owned Capio S:t Göran
The nine Sussa regions that went live in 2024–2025
Stockholm City’s municipal IT board
Cambio’s Sri Lanka engineering organisation

cards.hint: Bildad 2007; åtta regioner plus ett sjukhus.
cards.reword: Vad ingår i KGC utöver åtta regioner?
cards.explain: KGC (formed 2007) is eight long-standing regions — Jämtland Härjedalen, Jönköping, Kalmar, Kronoberg, Uppsala, Värmland, Västmanland and Östergötland — plus Capio S:t Göran. Their support and maintenance agreement was extended from 1 January 2024 for five years, with a possible further three. [S25]

cards.prompt: Varför ska du inte blanda ihop Region Stockholm och Stockholms stad här?

options.label: Regionen upphandlar Cosmic (ersätter TakeCare); staden skrev 2026 avtal med Tieto Caretech Lifecare för kommunala utförare
De är samma kund och samma system
Staden kör COSMIC som huvudjournal
Regionen valde Lifecare som huvudjournalsystem

cards.hint: Hälso- och sjukvård kontra kommunal omsorg.
cards.reword: How is Stockholms stad’s March 2026 system choice different from Region Stockholm’s EHR deal?
cards.explain: Region Stockholm is healthcare: Cosmic replacing TakeCare by about 2029. On 25 March 2026 Stockholms stad signed Tieto Caretech Lifecare for executors in social services, elderly care and municipal healthcare, for up to 13 years. Different customer, different product. [S26, S53]

cards.prompt: What should you not claim about Companion and the EU AI Act?

options.label: That Companion is formally classified as a high-risk AI system — Cambio has not published that classification here
That the AI Act can never apply alongside GDPR or patientdatalagen
That IMY has stated Companion is outside the AI Act
That NIS2 replaced the AI Act for all EHR vendors

cards.hint: Förordningen kan gälla parallellt med GDPR/PDL; Companion-klassningen är inte publicerad i packen.
cards.reword: Vad ska du inte hitta på om COSMIC Companion och AI-förordningen?
cards.explain: The AI Act is Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. IMY states that if personal data are processed when an organisation develops or uses AI, the AI Act may apply in parallel with GDPR/PDL. Do not tell an interviewer that Companion is formally classified as a high-risk AI system — that classification is not published on the pages fetched for this pack. [S39, S42]

cards.prompt: Vilket påstående om hosting ska du undvika?

options.label: Att produktionen av COSMIC körs hos en namngiven molnleverantör
Att Open Services-portalen anges som powered by Azure API Management
Att MittVaccin beskrivs som svensk SaaS med lagring och bearbetning i Sverige
Att Sussa-COSMIC levereras som managed service

cards.hint: Ingen publik uppgift namnger molnleverantören för kärn-EHR:n.
cards.reword: What cloud claim is not supported by the cited sources?
cards.explain: No public statement was found naming the cloud vendor that hosts production COSMIC. Azure API Management is stated only for the Open Services developer portal. MittVaccin is described as Swedish SaaS with storage and processing in Sweden at a procured partner. Sussa COSMIC is delivered as a managed service without a named host. [S22, S18, S4]

cards.prompt: Which set of terms matches the public Associate AI Engineer ad?

options.label: Stockholm or Linköping; permanent with a 6-month trial; Swedish and English; background check; not described as the Companion product team
Remote-only from Colombo; English only
Fixed-term three months as Companion product owner in Reading
No screening, because the posting says the work is unsensitive

cards.hint: Plats, språk, prövotid och bakgrundskontroll står i annonsen; teamplacering på Companion gör det inte.
cards.reword: Vad stämmer om den utannonserade associate-rollen?
cards.explain: Employer: Cambio Healthcare Systems AB. Place: Stockholm or Linköping. Full-time, permanent, six-month trial period. Hybrid, three office days. Swedish and English. Background check on the final candidate because the role involves access to sensitive information. The ad is internal enablement on its face, not a Companion team placement. [S51]

cards.prompt: Which MDR class are COSMIC and CDS certified under?

options.label: Class IIa
Class I, same as MittVaccin
Class III only
They are not medical devices

cards.hint: BSI-certifikat för både journalsystemet och beslutsstödet.
cards.reword: Vilken MDR-klass har COSMIC och CDS enligt certifikatet Cambio publicerar?
cards.explain: Compliance page and BSI certificate MDR 771804 R000: Cambio COSMIC EHR — Class IIa and Cambio CDS — Class IIa. First issued 13 August 2024, expires 12 August 2029. MittVaccin is separately described as CE-marked under MDR Class I. [S36, S37, S18]

cards.prompt: Vilket avtalsvärde anger Region Stockholm för första perioden?

options.label: 2 375 miljoner kronor över tolv år
331,3 MSEK — det är Q1 2026-koncernintäkten
85 miljoner euro, som i en pressuppgift om Åland
1 000 MSEK, som obligationsramen

cards.hint: Första perioden, kvalitet plus pris, tolvårigt.
cards.reword: What first-term contract value did Region Stockholm state for Cosmic?
cards.explain: Region Stockholm states a first-term contract value of 2,375 million SEK over twelve years, chosen on a mix of price and quality. Cosmic is targeted in place by December 2029. The EUR 85 million over 18 years figure is press-reported for Åland, not Stockholm, and is not in Cambio’s award text. [S26, S33]

cards.prompt: How does MittVaccin differ from COSMIC and CDS on MDR class, as published?

options.label: MittVaccin is CE-marked under MDR Class I; COSMIC and CDS are Class IIa
All three are Class IIa
MittVaccin is Class III; the others are Class I
None of them are described as medical devices

cards.hint: En lättare klass än journalsystemet och CDS.
cards.reword: Vilken MDR-klass anger MittVaccins produktsida?
cards.explain: MittVaccin’s product page: CE-marked under MDR Class I. COSMIC and CDS are Class IIa. The annual report: MittVaccin contracted by 14 of 21 regions plus private providers at year-end 2025. [S18, S37, S4]

cards.prompt: Hur är NIS2 infört i svensk rätt enligt research-packen?

options.label: Delvis genom cybersäkerhetslagen (2025:1506), som trädde i kraft 15 januari 2026
Genom patientdatalagen (2008:355)
Genom MDR (EU) 2017/745
Det är inte infört och gäller bara banker

cards.hint: En svensk lag från december 2025, i kraft i januari 2026.
cards.reword: When did Sweden’s NIS2-related cybersäkerhetslag enter into force?
cards.explain: NIS2 is Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Sweden implemented it in part through cybersäkerhetslagen (2025:1506), issued 11 December 2025 and in force 15 January 2026. Healthcare is an in-scope sector. The pack does not classify whether Cambio itself is a direct operator under the Act; customers who are regions will still pass supply-chain expectations to a core EHR vendor. [S43, S44]

cards.prompt: What does the published ISO/IEC 27001 certificate for Cambio Healthcare Systems AB say?

options.label: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, valid until 11 January 2027, covering development, maintenance and sales of EHR applications and related services
It expired in 2024 and was not renewed
It certifies only the Colombo office
It is the MDR Class IIa device certificate

cards.hint: Intertek 0164637, utfärdat 6 november 2024.
cards.reword: Vad gäller Cambio:s publicerade ISO 27001-certifikat?
cards.explain: Intertek certificate 0164637 for Cambio Healthcare Systems AB, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, issued 6 November 2024 and valid until 11 January 2027. Scope: development, maintenance and sales of EHR applications and related implementation and support services. Additional certified sites include Linköping, Reading, Colombo and Aarhus. [S7]

cards.prompt: Vad gäller som huvudregel för hur länge journaluppgifter och åtkomstloggar ska sparas, enligt PDL/IMY-materialet i packen?

options.label: Journalhandlingar minst tio år efter sista anteckningen; åtkomstloggar minst fem år
Allt får raderas efter 30 dagar
Journaler två år, loggar tio år
Inget bevarandekrav finns i svensk rätt

cards.hint: Journal längre än logg.
cards.reword: Under the Swedish record-keeping rules cited via IMY, how long must records and access logs generally be kept?
cards.explain: Journal documents must as a rule be retained at least ten years after the last entry (patientdatalagen 3 kap. 17 §). Access logs must be stored at least five years (HSLF-FS 2016:40 4 kap. 9 b §). [S38, S39]

cards.prompt: How do Cambio CIS and CDC relate?

options.label: CIS is a PDMS for anaesthesia and intensive care; CDC connects medical devices and translates their data
CDC is the regional EHR and CIS is the municipal system
Both are names for COSMIC Companion
CIS is only the FHIR sandbox

cards.hint: IVA och anestesi kontra koppling av mer än 900 medicintekniska produkter.
cards.reword: Vad är skillnaden mellan Cambio CIS och CDC?
cards.explain: CIS is a patient data management system for anaesthesia and intensive care (modules CIS IVA & NEO and CIS AN), described as integrated with COSMIC. CDC (Cambio Device Connectivity) connects more than 900 medical devices onto one platform and translates the data into a uniform language. [S15, S16]

cards.reword: What do cited sources say Systematic did in the Stockholm/Gotland EHR procurement?
cards.explain: Systematic competed for Stockholm/Gotland and appealed the award. Läkartidningen reported that the Administrative Court of Appeal refused leave (27 October 2025). [S29]

cards.reword: Vad säger källorna om Millennium i Sverige?
cards.explain: Millennium was excluded from the Stockholm/Gotland procurement at qualification; the appeal was lost. Svensk Farmaci reported that both Skåne and Västra Götaland decided in April 2026 to abandon their Millennium paths. [S26, S48]
